mapper.sql: select id, student_profile_num, adid, student_name_local, class_name_local, class_num, id_english_name, english_first_name, english_last_name, student_id_num, student_album_name, student_user_id_wecom, student_name_wecom, match_status, sync_status, error_msg, create_time, update_time from sys_student_match
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_student_match ( student_profile_num, adid, student_name_local, class_name_local, class_num, id_english_name, english_first_name, english_last_name, student_id_num, student_album_name, student_user_id_wecom, student_name_wecom, match_status, sync_status, error_msg, create_time ) VALUES
( #{item.studentProfileNum}, #{item.adid}, #{item.studentNameLocal}, #{item.classNameLocal}, #{item.classNum}, #{item.idEnglishName}, #{item.englishFirstName}, #{item.englishLastName}, #{item.studentIdNum}, #{item.studentAlbumName}, #{item.studentUserIdWecom}, #{item.studentNameWecom}, #{item.matchStatus}, #{item.syncStatus}, #{item.errorMsg}, SYSDATE() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE adid = VALUES(adid), student_name_local = VALUES(student_name_local), class_name_local = VALUES(class_name_local), class_num = VALUES(class_num), id_english_name = VALUES(id_english_name), english_first_name = VALUES(english_first_name), english_last_name = VALUES(english_last_name), student_id_num = VALUES(student_id_num), student_album_name = VALUES(student_album_name), student_user_id_wecom = IF(sync_status = '1', student_user_id_wecom, VALUES(student_user_id_wecom)), student_name_wecom = IF(sync_status = '1', student_name_wecom, VALUES(student_name_wecom)), match_status = IF(sync_status = '1', match_status, VALUES(match_status)), update_time = SYSDATE()
mapper.select:
where match_status = '0'
and (student_name_local like concat('%', #{studentNameLocal}, '%') or student_name_wecom like concat('%', #{studentNameLocal}, '%'))
and class_name_local like concat('%', #{classNameLocal}, '%')
order by id desc

SELECT DISTINCT r.student_user_id AS student_user_id, r.student_name AS student_name, r.mobile AS mobile, r.relation_desc AS relation_desc, cs.class_section_sp AS class_code_wecom FROM sys_parent_student_relation r LEFT JOIN sys_department_parent_binding b ON r.student_user_id = b.student_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON b.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE r.student_user_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT student_user_id_wecom FROM sys_student_match WHERE student_user_id_wecom IS NOT NULL )
AND ( r.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryNameTraditional}, '%') OR r.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryNameSimplified}, '%') )
AND r.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryMobile}, '%')
AND cs.class_section_sp LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryClass}, '%')
ORDER BY r.student_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.student_user_id AS student_user_id, r.student_name AS student_name, cs.class_section_sp AS class_code_wecom FROM sys_parent_student_relation r INNER JOIN sys_department_parent_binding b ON r.student_user_id = b.student_user_id INNER JOIN sys_department d ON b.department_id = d.id INNER JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
